question: L4003 left four items without a check: which head-table index each weapon uses, how the seven non-matching rates of fire are derived, how the site reload totals relate to the stored reload rows, and why the Interdictor's limb value is 1.0 against EA's sniper figure 0.67.

sourceFacts.method: Registry rows per weapon (w1/rows.json, equal to own values by L4000) were combined with site data. Head: registry DamageProtectionMultiplierIndex against the site's protectionIndex, and the L3362 head table at that index against the site's headshot value. Cycle rate: 60 / (60 / RateOfFire + BoltActionDelay + BoltActionTime / BoltActionSpeed). Reload: ReloadInfoArray[0] ReloadDelay + PostReloadDelay + ReloadTimeBulletsLeft against tacRld, and ReloadInfoArray[1] ReloadTimeBulletsLeft against emptyRld, the best of 50 field sums tried. EA lines were read from the saved note texts.

control.description: M433: index 11, head table 1.4, site headshot 1.4. The cycle formula reproduces all seven site rates within 0.01 per minute.

eaLines.miniScoutLimb: Reduced the Mini Scout limb damage to better align with lower-torso damage values.
eaLines.vssmLimb: VSSM limb damage multipliers have been adjusted.
eaLines.matchTrigger: The Match Trigger attachment no longer affects fully automatic fire on the BROD and EF88.
eaLines.interdictorLimb: Limb damage now matches chest damage

inference: Every site weapon's head multiplier is the L3362 head table at the weapon's stored index: 11 for the 41 automatic weapons and the vz. 61, 3 for the six sniper rifles, 1, 2 or 4 for DMRs and sidearms, 0 for shotguns.

The seven bolt-action and pump rates the site shows are the stored cycle: shot interval plus bolt delay plus bolt time divided by bolt speed. The KS-K, DB-12 and M44 have bolt rows but the site rate equals RateOfFire.

Site reload totals equal the stored sums on 48 of 63 tactical and 45 of 58 empty values. The others are above the stored sum by a whole number of 1/60 s frames in most cases; they are the capture-based values reviewed in L123 and L105.
EA's notes say the Interdictor's limb damage matches chest damage, which is the stored 1.0 and the site's value; the general sniper figure 0.67 does not apply to it.

EA's line that Match Trigger no longer affects fully automatic fire on the BROD and EF88 treats an effect on automatic fire as a defect. That supports the L17 reading that the Match Trigger effect is meant for single fire only; it does not show the size of the effect.
unresolved: Why 16 reload totals sit a few frames above the stored sums is not derived from source here; the site keeps the reviewed values.
The Match Trigger statement is wording, not a measurement; the L17 semi against auto test still applies.
siteImpact: None. No Analyzer data, simulation or UI change.

leads.title: Follow-ups to L4003: head-table index equal on 63 of 63; seven cycle rates reproduced from stored bolt fields; reload sums equal on 48 tactical and 45 of 58 empty values; EA explains the Interdictor limb value and says Match Trigger must not affect automatic fire
leads.summary: Head-table index and value equal the site on 63 of 63 weapons. Seven manually cycled rates are reproduced from stored bolt fields. Reload sums equal the site on 48 tactical and 45 of 58 empty values; the rest are reviewed capture values. EA states the Interdictor's limb damage matches chest damage, and that Match Trigger must not affect automatic fire. No site value changes. 166 raw-offset checks matched.
